title: Support thread on retention
caption: A chat thread changes the policy: 90 days on Enterprise, 30 on every other plan.
verdict: A short chat thread changes a policy: from 1 May, Enterprise exports are kept for 90 days and every other plan stays at 30. The agent replaces the single 30-day claim with one claim per plan.
lesson: Decisions often arrive in chat, not in documents. Filing them on the policy page means the next reader finds them without knowing the thread exists.
